sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

It's about creating a character that stands out from the crowd, one that exudes confidence, style, and a hint of celebrity status.

As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new items, styles, and accessories to add to your character's wardrobe. You'll also have the opportunity to take selfies and share them with the world. The more likes you get, the more items you can buy, and the more styles you can explore. It's a never-ending cycle of self-expression, creativity, and social interaction.
